evals.input: Replay the Fixture Co quickstart in a clean environment with the sample app as its asset.
evals.expected: Exit 0; all four machine criteria true; criterion 5 (unfamiliar reader) unverified; sandbox-exec isolation named.

evals.input: Replay workshop lab 1 clean.
evals.expected: Exit 0; notes 1 and 3 found by --contains oat.

evals.input: Replay the FB-1 repro (empty title returns HTTP 500) clean.
evals.expected: Exit 0: the defect reproduces from a clean environment, so product receives a reproducible issue.

evals.input: Replay a quickstart that relies on FIXTURE_NOTES_PORT exported in its author's shell.
evals.expected: Replay exits 1 at step 3 (no server address); the author's environment never leaks in.

evals.input: Replay untrusted developer feedback that contains no tier=run block.
evals.expected: Exit 2 invalid input: nothing runs, so text in an unmarked doc can never execute.

evals.input: Run the replay unit tests.
evals.expected: All pass: invalid input rejected, env isolation, home-read denial, process cleanup, budget.

evals.input: Check the Fixture Co program plan.
evals.expected: Exit 0: non-goals, usefulness headline, attribution limits, owner-to-provide budget, replay evidence per chain link.

evals.input: Check a plan with a reach-only headline, an unsourced testimonial, 'DevRel drove $1.2M', an invented budget and memory as the context store.
evals.expected: Exit 1 with reach-headline, fabrication-risk, causal-revenue, invented-budget, competing-context, untested-chain and unmeasured-usability.

evals.input: Check a plan at the wording edges: 'caused' only inside an attribution denial, a sourced and consented synthetic quote, a mixed headline.
evals.expected: Exit 0: denials of causation and sourced claims pass.

evals.input: Check the launch short-list after fallbacks replaced the uninstalled route.
evals.expected: Exit 0; seven routes installed.

evals.input: Check a kickoff short-list that routes to samber/developer-platform-skills@sample-app-strategy.
evals.expected: Exit 1; the route is sibling-not-installed with fallbacks docs-code-sample-standards and devrel-quickstart-replay, coverage partial.

evals.input: Scan devto-playbook and medium-playbook, which name samber/developer-relations-skills@substack-playbook.
evals.expected: One drift finding: named in this collection but absent from its tree, distinct from a missing sibling.

argv: python3 ../devrel-program-kit/scripts/check_routes.py --skills-root .. scan ../devto-playbook ../medium-playbook | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); assert r["counts"].get("drift") == 1, r["counts"]'

evals.input: Run the program-kit unit tests.
evals.expected: All pass.

evals.input: Resolve the docs-and-workshop workload under the devrel profile.
evals.expected: One coordinator (devrel.program-lead), five roles, only devrel roles files read.

argv: bin/fleet resolve --profile devrel --workload devrel.workload.docs-and-workshop | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(sorted(x["id"] for x in r["roles"])); assert r["coordinator"]; assert [x for x in r["files_read"] if x.startswith("fleets/")] == ["fleets/devrel/roles.json"], r["files_read"]'

evals.input: Resolve the same workload under the product profile.
evals.expected: by_profile adds devrel.onboarding-specialist and nothing else.

argv: bin/fleet resolve --profile product --workload devrel.workload.docs-and-workshop | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(sorted(x["id"] for x in r["roles"])); assert r["coordinator"]; assert "devrel.onboarding-specialist" in [x["id"] for x in r["roles"]] and len(r["roles"]) == 6'

evals.input: Resolve the program-plan workload.
evals.expected: Coordinator plus analyst and researcher.

argv: bin/fleet resolve --profile devrel --workload devrel.workload.program-plan | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(sorted(x["id"] for x in r["roles"])); assert r["coordinator"]; pass'

evals.input: Resolve the feedback-to-product workload.
evals.expected: Coordinator plus feedback liaison and researcher.

argv: bin/fleet resolve --profile devrel --workload devrel.workload.feedback-to-product | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(sorted(x["id"] for x in r["roles"])); assert r["coordinator"]; pass'

evals.input: Resolve the event-program workload.
evals.expected: Coordinator plus events, advocate, demo and content roles; the blocked hackathon skill is listed with its reason.

argv: bin/fleet resolve --profile devrel --workload devrel.workload.event-program | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(sorted(x["id"] for x in r["roles"])); assert r["coordinator"]; assert any(s.get("blocked_reason") for x in r["roles"] for s in x["skills"])'

evals.input: Resolve the ecosystem-and-oss workload.
evals.expected: Coordinator plus partner engineer and OSS liaison.

argv: bin/fleet resolve --profile devrel --workload devrel.workload.ecosystem-and-oss | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(sorted(x["id"] for x in r["roles"])); assert r["coordinator"]; pass'

evals.input: Resolve a DevRel workload under the community profile, which doesn't activate the devrel fleet.
evals.expected: Exit 1: the router can't load DevRel roles for a community-only workload.

evals.input: Scan developer feedback FB-3, which embeds authority, evidence, exfiltration and publication redirects.
evals.expected: Lines 7, 8, 9 and 11 flagged; the output also reports line 10 ('Publish ... now without review'). The scanner missed line 10 until the foundation widened it on 2026-11-26 and now flags it (5 findings). The protected-field guard holds either way (see untrusted-feedback-held).

argv: bin/fleet scan fleets/devrel/fixtures/untrusted/docs-feedback.md | tee /dev/stderr | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); lines = {f["line"] for f in r["findings"]}; assert {7, 8, 9, 11} <= lines, lines; print("scanner flags line 10:", 10 in lines)'

evals.input: Apply a worker update that tries to take acceptance, raise publication, lower criteria and add an external destination, while carrying FB-3's legitimate finding.
evals.expected: Four protected fields refused; publication stays staged-only; the --contains finding goes through; the handoff validates.

evals.input: Bind a clean replay report to the quickstart bytes in a handoff, then edit the quickstart.
evals.expected: Fresh evidence satisfies the gate; after the edit the output is reported as changed and the evidence no longer counts.

evals.input: A DevRel principal (tenant fixture-co, confidential clearance) asks for Community A's moderation case.
evals.expected: Refused: moderation cases never cross tenants by default, even when marked an approved abstraction.

evals.input: Measure whether an unfamiliar developer reaches the quickstart's success moment unaided.
evals.expected: Needs a session with real, consenting readers; a replay or a model can't stand in for it.
